nodes.name: Ensure Reminder Tracking Table
nodes.notes: Idempotent bootstrap — this repo tracks new tables as loose .sql files (see book_confirmed_reminders_add.sql) applied manually, but this CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lets the workflow self-provision on first run without requiring that manual step.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS booking_confirmed_reminders (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  activity_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reminder_step TEXT NOT NULL,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (activity_id, reminder_step)
);

SELECT
  a.id AS activity_id,
  a.due_at,
  a.subject AS activity_subject,
  c.id AS contact_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.timezone, c.unsubscribe_token,
  CASE WHEN a.due_at - now() <= interval '2 hours' THEN 'booking_reminder_2h' ELSE 'booking_reminder_24h' END AS reminder_step
FROM activities a
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id
JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = a.opportunity_id
WHERE a.type = 'meeting'
  AND a.due_at > now()
  AND a.due_at - now() <= interval '24 hours'
  AND o.status = 'Open'
  AND o.stage_id = 19
  AND c.is_archived = false
  AND c.do_not_contact = false
  AND c.dnc_email = false
  AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM booking_confirmed_reminders bcr
    WHERE bcr.activity_id = a.id
      AND bcr.reminder_step = (CASE WHEN a.due_at - now() <= interval '2 hours' THEN 'booking_reminder_2h' ELSE 'booking_reminder_24h' END)
  );

nodes.name: Select Due Appointment Reminders
nodes.notes: Gated on the deal still being o.status='Open' AND o.stage_id=19 (the exact stage Public Booking.json's 'Create Inspection Deal' node puts a new booking into) instead of a.is_completed — this way ANY stage move off the booked stage stops reminders automatically, regardless of why: rep drags the card to Closed Lost (cancelled by phone), forward to Inspection Done, or the contact cancels via the email link (which just sets status='Lost', no stage lookup needed). Recomputes reminder_step from due_at every poll rather than tracking a fixed 'next step' — if the engine ever misses the 24h window (downtime), an appointment that's now under 2h away correctly jumps straight to the 2h reminder instead of sending a stale 'tomorrow' email late. The anti-join on booking_confirmed_reminders (keyed on activity_id + the SPECIFIC step) is what prevents re-sending a step already sent.

parameters.query:

  c.id AS contact_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.timezone, c.unsubscribe_token
FROM activities a
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id
WHERE a.id = $1;

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id AS activity_id, a.due_at, a.is_completed, a.subject AS activity_subject,
  o.id AS opportunity_id, o.status AS opportunity_status, o.stage_id,
  s.name AS stage_name,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM booking_confirmed_reminders bcr WHERE bcr.activity_id = a.id AND bcr.reminder_step = 'booking_reminder_24h') AS reminder_24h_sent,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM booking_confirmed_reminders bcr WHERE bcr.activity_id = a.id AND bcr.reminder_step = 'booking_reminder_2h') AS reminder_2h_sent
FROM activities a
JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = a.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN stages s ON s.id = o.stage_id
WHERE a.contact_id = $1 AND a.type = 'meeting'
ORDER BY a.due_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
